headline: House at the Top of the Hill / Skupaj Arhitekti
context: Project and context - House at the Top of the Hill is situated in the Radgona-Kapela Hills of northeastern Slovenia. Conceived as a retreat from the capital for occasional stays, it brings quiet, daylight, weather and views into everyday life.
